name: Life with Idol
source:
The entertainment agency "Izumipro" is searching for new stars. A young female ghost woman possesses agency's president to get in touch with these young talents and remember about her own past...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
演藝經紀公司「Izumipro」正在尋找新星。一名年輕女幽靈附身於事務所社長，藉此接觸這些年輕新秀，並回想自己的過去……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
